name: Guts Iron Condor
summary: An iron condor built from ITM shorts (short ITM call and short ITM put, i.e. a short guts strangle) with OTM long wings - structurally equivalent to a normal iron condor but with enormous early-assignment exposure. BAD IDEA on American-style equities.

legs.strike_rule: OTM put wing, below spot by W
ITM put: strike ABOVE spot (delta about -0.70)
ITM call: strike BELOW spot (delta about 0.70)
OTM call wing, above spot by W

max_profit: net credit - the intrinsic value embedded in the ITM shorts; economically identical to the equivalent OTM iron condor
max_loss: (wing distance - net credit) x 100, same as the equivalent OTM iron condor
breakevens: identical to the equivalent OTM iron condor at the same strikes
when_to_use: Essentially never on US equities/ETFs. It exists because ITM strikes are occasionally more liquid or better priced on some products, and because of put-call parity the payoff is identical to the OTM version. On European cash-settled index options it is harmless; on American share-settled options it is not.
entry_rules: DO NOT TRADE on this system. Included for completeness only.
If ever used: both shorts are deep ITM from the moment of entry, so the assignment guard fires immediately - which is why the OTM-equivalent iron condor is always the correct expression
Alpaca level 3 would technically permit it (defined risk), which is exactly the trap
management_rules: Not applicable - the position should not be opened. If inherited from a roll gone wrong, close it the same session.
exit_rules: Close immediately and unconditionally; ITM shorts with extrinsic under $0.10 will be assigned, and both sides are ITM by construction
Never hold overnight; never hold over an ex-dividend date
assignment_risk: Maximum. Both short legs are ITM at entry. On American-style share-settled options, assignment is a question of when, not if.
buying_power: (wing distance - credit) x 100, but brokers often hold more pending assignment resolution.
common_mistakes: Believing put-call parity makes it equivalent in practice; it is equivalent in payoff and catastrophic in settlement mechanics on American options.
zero_dte_notes: Absolutely not. Guaranteed ITM shorts on expiration day means guaranteed assignment.
family: four-leg structures (iron condors, iron butterflies, condors, double calendars/diagonals, boxes, jelly rolls, conversions/reversals, double verticals, double ratio spreads)
